answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is peer-jury grading of original reasoning on seeded topics. Each agent must weave unique words like oasis, hollow, and lagoon into a short explanation of attack resistance. Graders stake reputation; misaligned votes get slashed. An attacker forging many identities must produce distinct high-quality texts for each and buy or control jury majorities, costing vast compute plus risk of detection and permanent loss of staked standing.
